title: Clearer app authorization and key guidance
summary:
Clearer authorization, a new developer-tool listing, and a provider change for DeepSeek V3.2.

The authorization page now lists text, image, audio, and video permissions alongside Pollen balance, key expiry, and model access. API-key guidance was also corrected across the docs and product surfaces: publishable keys are described as limited to 1 Pollen per IP per hour, and both key types spend from the account balance. The rate-limit behavior itself did not change.

PolliDev, a tool for managing generative image assets and prompts, was added to the Dev_Tools catalog and README showcase. The YouTube MASHINA showcase entry was removed.

DeepSeek V3.2 now routes through Fireworks AI in the shared model registry and text API. Its `deepseek-v3` and `deepseek-reasoning` aliases remain; provider-specific token overrides were also removed for GLM-4.7 and MiniMax M2.1.
